# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 7 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 7 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_007_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 7

**7:1** When Mary was two years old, Joachim brought up the subject with Anna: "We need to take her to the temple to fulfill the vow we made. If we delay, we might bring trouble on ourselves and God won't accept our offering."

**7:2** Anna hesitated. "Let's wait one more year — until she's three. Then she won't be crying for us after we leave her." Joachim agreed.

**7:3** When Mary turned three, Joachim said: "Let's ask the pure young women of Israel to come along — and have each one carry a lit lamp. That way Mary will keep moving forward and won't look back and lose heart before we reach the temple."

**7:4** They did exactly that. The procession made its way up to the temple, and when they arrived, the priest came out to meet them. He took Mary in his arms, kissed her, and blessed her: "God has made your name great for all generations to come. Through you, God will reveal his salvation to Israel in the last days."

**7:5** He carried her to the third step of the altar and set her there. God's grace fell on her — and the little girl began to dance! The whole house of Israel watched in delight and fell in love with her.
